positioning_statement: KORE occupies a unique position: high operational maturity + high connectivity options. Most competitors can only claim one of these. Its competitive advantage is not any single feature — it's the combination of scale, experience, end-to-end infrastructure, and regulated-vertical depth that most competitors cannot match together.

named_competitors.name: Emnify
named_competitors.notes: A dedicated fact-based comparison reference exists (differentiators, coverage, pricing, verticals, FAQ) — use only for content explicitly positioning KORE against Emnify.

competitor_categories.gap: Strong developer tooling, thin on logistics/compliance

competitor_categories.kore_advantage: Full lifecycle from SIM to device to logistics

positioning_framework: If a competitor solves the connectivity layer -> KORE solves the entire deployment
If a competitor is strong in one region -> KORE delivers localized global coverage
If a competitor works well at early scale -> KORE is built for enterprise scale
If a competitor serves commercial verticals -> KORE covers regulated, mission-critical verticals too
when_kore_is_the_clear_choice: Enterprise deployments spanning multiple geographies, verticals, or regulatory environments
Organizations needing a single point of accountability: hardware, SIM, logistics, lifecycle management
Regulated verticals requiring compliance documentation: healthcare, industrial, utilities, government
Multi-technology deployments: cellular + LoRaWAN + satellite from one platform
High-device-count deployments where cost governance, data pooling, and spend controls matter
Buyers evaluating a 5-10 year strategic partnership, not a commodity SIM vendor
rules: Do not name competitors unless it's an explicitly approved comparison piece
Do not claim KORE is 'the best' without a specific, substantiated proof point
Do not frame competitors as inferior — frame KORE's advantages as right for the right buyer
Do not lead with technology specs — lead with business outcomes and buyer scenarios
Do not use passive language ("KORE is known for...") — use active, confident assertions ("KORE manages 20M+ active connections globally")
